**Migration done in 12 files.** All 36 `db.query` calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Syntax checks pass.

Two calls stay on the old form in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. I left `cache.query` alone. It is a different object.

Next: patch `legacy-orm` upstream, or wrap it locally before the driver drops `query`.
